answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a crystal mechanism for identity, where the kernel of an agent’s influence is tethered to locked capital. By requiring verifiable economic commitment, the system ensures that spinning up a new ember of identity provides zero marginal network power. An attacker must incur massive capital expenditure to gain influence, rendering Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive compared to the probabilistic gains of illicit consensus manipulation within the decentralized economy.
